d: The Clippers defeated the Thunder, 113-112 tonight in LA. Brook Lopez contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 7 rebounds 4 assists and 3 three pointers, with Darius Garland of the Clippers adding an additional 24 points (8-17 FG, 3-7 3P) in the game. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 40 points along with 5 assists for the Thunder in the losing effort. The Clippers improve their record to 3-8 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 8-5 for the season.
